deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PROD canary deploy started: SDK v0.16 -> core-api (canary=5%) at 2026-03-15T09:07:14Z

maya (oncall): getting paged — high error rate hitting /v1/paging/stream and client connections are dropping. seeing 502s and protocol errors.

maya (oncall): stack traces show `ClientError: unexpected frame type` from sdk-client streaming code. suspect breaking change in client framing

sam (eng): looking. rolling logs now. can you paste a failing request/response?

maya (oncall): here's a curl capture from a canary that failed:
```
POST /v1/paging/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx

{"cursor":"abc","limit":50}
```
response: 400 Bad Request
{"error":"invalid_stream_frame","message":"unknown frame opcode 0x7f"}

liam (sre): adding traces, creating ingestion filter. paging latency spike to 3.2s and 15% 5xx on canary shard.

inc-bot: Incident created INC-2026-041: SDK 0.16 paging / streaming incompatibility — severity: P1 — paging clients affected.

nina (cs): heads-up: 3 enterprise customers hit a meltdown alert. CS is on the line with one customer right now (AcmeHealth). collecting list and impact.

sam (eng): quick triage: SDK v0.16 bumped client-side streaming framing to new length-prefixed binary frames. server expected legacy text-delimited frames unless negotiate flag set. canary clients used new framing. missed compatibility gate in release.

jordan (release): rolling the canary back to v0.15 on canary hosts now. initiating rollback playbook.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step: disable flag `sdk_enable_v0_16_framing` in prod config service. API: POST /admin/flags/disable?sdk_enable_v0_16_framing

maya (oncall): disabling flag now. commands:
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.ai/admin/flags/disable?sdk_enable_v0_16_framing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
response: 200 OK — flag disabled.

liam (sre): observed error rate drop on canary hosts to baseline in ~45s. rolling canary rollback progressing.

sam (eng): pushing hotfix candidate: compatibility shim that accepts both legacy and new frames and toggles by header. will push to dedicated fallback route first.

hazel (pm): capture affected SDK callers list and scope for patch release. customers on older client versions might be fine but any clients that auto-upgraded to v0.16 are impacted.

nina (cs): affected customer list so far: AcmeHealth (sev2), FinCraft (sev3), BrightLearn (sev2). CS is sending status pings.

maya (oncall): handing off to sam for next shift — summary: canary failed due to framing incompat.; immediate mitigation: disabled `sdk_enable_v0_16_framing` flag + canary rollback to v0.15; monitor for residual errors; follow-up: patch release v0.16.1 with compatibility shim and release notes.

sam (eng): taking over. creating follow-up ticket POL-297: SDK 0.16 compatibility shim + tests. tagging QA for regression.

liam (sre): monitoring dashboards — no customer-facing degradation after rollback except intermittent reconnects. setting 1hr watch.

inc-bot: Updated incident INC-2026-041: mitigation applied (flag disabled, rollback). Assigning owners: eng=sam, cs=nina, sres=liam.

jordan (release): blocking re-release until shim and end-to-end tests for streaming/paging are green. will require a feature gate + canary with protocol negotiation enabled.

nina (cs): scheduled customer outreach: status update in 30m, root-cause summary to affected customers when incident is stable.

sam (eng): quick repro steps and test added to ci: new test asserts server accepts both `\n` delimited and length-prefixed frames. pushing branch now.

maya (oncall): thanks — logging handoff in rotation doc. leaving noise muted.

hazel (pm): action items: 1) publish SDK 0.16.1 compatibility patch + changelog, 2) add protocol negotiation in SDK and server, 3) postmortem with timeline and why compatibility gate missed. owners: sam/jordan/hazel.

liam (sre): adding incident notes to postmortems folder. will schedule blameless RCA.

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-041 status changed to "Mitigated" at 2026-03-15T13:20:00Z.

sam (eng): leaving follow-ups: repro, unit tests, canary procedure update, upgrade guide for customers. I'll coordinate with CS to inform customers of safe upgrade path.

nina (cs): will compile a list of customers who auto-updated and prepare personalized remediation steps.

maya (oncall): closing primary page. if errors reappear ping @maya or escalate to @liam. :thumbsup:
